comments.body: Checked publish timestamps: four articles from Wed–Fri this week 404; last week's set is fine. Cron job kb_public_mv_refresh last success was Monday 00:05 UTC.

content.text: Checked publish timestamps: four articles from Wed–Fri this week 404; last week's set is fine. Cron job kb_public_mv_refresh last success was Monday 00:05 UTC.

Deep links to knowledge base articles published in the current calendar week return HTTP 404 from the public help host. Older articles (published before Monday 00:00 UTC of the current week) resolve normally.
Agents paste these links into ticket replies; customers hit 404 and reply that the article is missing. CDN purge does not help.

Hypothesis: the public article router resolves slug via a weekly materialized view refreshed by a Monday cron. Articles inserted after the last refresh exist in the authoring DB and internal preview but are absent from the view the public edge queries.
Workaround is linking the internal preview URL, which is undesirable for customers.
